decision_conditions: The Council consider that the impact of the proposed development, by reason of its depth, height and proximity to the shared boundaries with nos. 34 and 38 Daventry Road, would be an intrusive and unneighbourly development which would have an overbearing impact, resulting in a significant loss of outlook and an increased sense of enclosure to the detriment of the amenity of these adjacent occupiers.

This written notice indicates that the proposed development would not comply with condition A.4 of Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015.  It is important to note that this written notice does not indicate whether or not the proposed development would comply with any of the other limitations of conditions of Schedule 2 Part 1 Class A.
The applicant has the right to an appeal against this notice to the Planning Inspectorate, see details below.
description: Single storey rear extension with an overall depth of 6m, a maximum height of 3m, and an eaves height of 2.90m. (PRIOR APPROVAL)
